lines.en: Rui, you look exhausted. Did you miss the eight o’clock train again? The platform is empty and the board says it left.
lines.pt: Rui, você parece exausto. Perdeu o trem das oito de novo? A plataforma está vazia e o painel diz que ele saiu.

lines.en: Yes, Dirk. My alarm did not ring, and the subway was delayed for twenty minutes. I will have to wait for the next one.
lines.pt: Sim, Dirk. Meu despertador não tocou e o metrô atrasou vinte minutos. Vou ter que esperar o próximo.

lines.en: If I were you, I would have left earlier. A delay on this line is nothing new, and winter makes it worse.
lines.pt: Se eu fosse você, teria saído mais cedo. Atraso nesta linha não é novidade, e o inverno piora tudo.

lines.en: It is easy to say that now. If I knew the future, I would have taken a taxi from my apartment.
lines.pt: É fácil dizer isso agora. Se eu soubesse o futuro, teria pegado um táxi do meu apartamento.

lines.en: Fair enough. If I were in your position, I would have checked the website the night before, just to be safe.
lines.pt: Justo. Se eu estivesse no seu lugar, teria conferido o site na noite anterior, só por segurança.

lines.en: I did check it. It said the line was on time, so I did not worry. Sometimes those sites are simply wrong.
lines.pt: Eu conferi. Dizia que a linha estava no horário, então não me preocupei. Às vezes esses sites erram mesmo.

lines.en: It was not your fault. If I were you, I would complain to the company, because you pay for a reliable service.
lines.pt: Não foi culpa sua. Se eu fosse você, reclamaria à empresa, porque você paga por um serviço confiável.

lines.en: The meeting in Milwaukee starts at eleven, and I wish I had called my boss before the train left.
lines.pt: A reunião em Milwaukee começa às onze e queria ter ligado para meu chefe antes de o trem sair.

lines.en: Call him now. If I were you, I would explain everything, and he would probably understand, since the weather is awful.
lines.pt: Ligue agora. Se eu fosse você, explicaria tudo, e ele provavelmente entenderia, já que o tempo está horrível.

lines.en: Good idea. And if I had a better schedule, I would travel the night before, so I would not be this nervous.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. E se eu tivesse uma agenda melhor, viajaria na noite anterior, então não estaria tão nervoso.

lines.en: Let us find a coffee first. The next train leaves in forty minutes, and I will wait with you.
lines.pt: Vamos tomar um café primeiro. O próximo trem sai em quarenta minutos e eu espero com você.

facts.big: If I were you, I would have…
facts.label: Conselho sobre o passado
facts.sub: If + passado simples, would have + particípio.

facts.label: If I were you, I would have + particípio
facts.sub: Use este molde para criticar ou aconselhar sobre o passado: If I were you, I would have left earlier. O if fala de uma situação imaginada; o resultado fala de uma ação passada.

facts.big: Misto: tempo do if e do resultado
facts.label: past simple + would have
facts.sub: Neste tipo misto o if usa passado simples, mas o resultado se refere ao passado: If I knew the future, I would have taken a taxi.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: If I were you, I would have left earlier is advice about the past.
We say “If I was you” in formal writing.
Would have left refers to a past action.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: If I were you, I would have left earlier is advice about the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “If I was you” in formal writing. → Falso (Formal English prefers were.)
Would have left refers to a past action. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: If I were you · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold day in Chicago. Dirk waits at the big station. A voice announces a delay. People hurry with bags. Rui walks in. The platform is already empty.

“Rui, you look exhausted. Did you miss the eight o’clock train again? The platform is empty and the board says it left.” says Dirk. “Yes, Dirk. My alarm did not ring, and the subway was delayed for twenty minutes. I will have to wait for the next one.” says Rui. “If I were you, I would have left earlier. A delay on this line is nothing new, and winter makes it worse.” says Dirk.
